name: research-deck
title_zh: 先问你什么要紧，再把实验材料排成三页主线的研究汇报
tagline_zh: 对着满文件夹的图、日志、纪要发怵？它先追问你这轮到底要说服谁，再只挑能撑起问题—解法—结果三页的证据。
tagline_en: Drowning in figures, logs, and notes? It interviews you on what actually matters, then builds a deck whose first.
desc_en: Turn a folder of experiment material — figures, run logs, experiment and model design notes, meeting notes — into a research deck (PPT / Keynote / HTML), after interviewing the user about what actually matters. why_zh: 别的工具按模板堆页，它按论证结构砍页。先访谈锁定主线，三页讲完核心，之后全是证据附录。你的图不重绘。
why_en: Template tools pile slides; this one cuts to an argument. It interviews you first, forces a 3-page spine.
limit_zh: 只吃文件夹里的现成材料，不生成新图；访谈只覆盖论证主线，不帮你做视觉美化或动画。
limit_en: Only consumes existing files—no figure generation. Interview covers argument structure only, not visual polish. Output is a PPT/Keynote/HTML.
